estimand: population log odds in independent fixed-margin binary tables

methods.common_effect_exact: one common exact conditional log odds per entity pair
methods.hierarchical_exact: donor-specific exact conditional log odds shrunk to a population field

objective_scope: pairwise composite over independent entity-pair 2x2 tables; no shared-pair dependence or coherent multivariate cell-level joint law is simulated
recipient_evaluation: independent held tables sampled at the population field; estimators receive only recipient row and column margins
selection: all hyperparameters and residual variants are fixed across scenarios; no outcome-based method or multiplier selection
